## Walkthrough The pull request updates 2.2 release metadata and dependencies, promotes `RecoverVolumeExpansionFailure` to GA, centralizes CLI configuration, modernizes controller handling, and pins release-tool actions and build inputs. ### Changes **Resizer modernization** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Dependencies and release metadata**

`pkg/features/features.go`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-2.2.md`|`RecoverVolumeExpansionFailure` is marked GA in code, Stable in the feature table, and GA in release notes.| |**CLI and controller modernization**
`cmd/csi-resizer/main.go`, `pkg/controller/...`, `pkg/modifycontroller/modify_volume.go`|Common flags use `standardflags.Configuration`, leader election uses the shared runner, callbacks use `any`, workers use `wg.Go`, and event calls are simplified.| |**Release workflow and build inputs**

v1.43.0 or later in go.mod, and keep related OpenTelemetry module versions
compatible; only retain v1.40.0 if the repository documents the specific
platform-scoped exception.

- Line 29: Update the detailed RecoverVolumeExpansionFailure option
documentation to use GA/stable wording instead of BETA, and revise the
surrounding alpha/experimental description as needed so it no longer categorizes
this feature as pre-stable while preserving descriptions of any genuinely
experimental features.

In `@release-tools/.github/workflows/trivy.yaml`:

pull_request event while preserving the existing daily schedule under schedule.
Ensure Trivy runs both for pull requests and at midnight UTC.
